reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE derivatives
reference_evidence_units.statement: Mobile LC phase gives homogeneous J-coupled columns.

reference_evidence_units.statement: kr doubles (1.4 vs 0.69 × 10^8 s-1); knr similar.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The 55% faster nonradiative rate of bulk 2 compared to that of bulk 1

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: J-type transition-dipole coupling in zigzag columns red-shifts and accelerates emission.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The bulk advantage is assigned to a faster kr, with knr set by stacking quality.
